spots.name: McNary Highway
spots.tip: A landmark bridge: try blue hour when the lights come on, or low side light that shows the structure.

spots.name: Lake Umatilla
spots.tip: A lake: calm air at dawn gives mirror reflections, and mist often sits on the water on cold mornings.

spots.name: Hermiston Butte
spots.tip: A notable summit. Check the road and trail first; first and last light on high ground is the reason to go, and it's often the subject from below. Summit 176 m (577 ft).

spots.name: Umatilla National Wildlife Refuge
spots.tip: Wildlife is most active in the first two hours after sunrise. Stay on trails, use your car as a blind on auto routes and give animals space.

spots.name: Sand Dune Beach
spots.tip: Low tide and wet sand give reflections at sunset. Check the tide table and never turn your back on the waves.
